R1.description: A Workflow protocol gate's wait for an external reviewer's verdict (a persisted protocol_gate block: disposition external_gate, action plan.review.external or implementation.review.external, at a manual-external phase) sends review_wait (INFO, LOW); a BLOCK-resolution gate, a Controller-coded gate and every legacy gate there stay user_gate (#149)

R2.description: The tester's fault stops send review_wait except isolation_breach (user_gate) and functional_unchanged (lane_blocked); a functional-review gate without a tester block stays user_gate (#149)

R3.description: Human gates, merge_pull_request and merge_held stay user_gate, pr_merged stays INFO/NORMAL and checks_pending is unchanged (#149)

R4.description: The guides and the roadmap state the new mapping (#149)

R5.description: The record writer persists protocol_gate for the Workflow's own gates without changing the blocked or pending-checks behaviour, and recovery treats a handled historical user_gate as handling the reclassified review_wait (#149)
